symptoms.symptom: The appliance is not cooling, the displays and lighting are lit.

causes.label: Showroom mode is switched on.
remedies: Switch off the appliance. Page 14
Wait 2 minutes.
Switch the appliance back on. Page 13
Wait 1 minute and then press and hold super cool
until 4 audible signals have sounded.
After a short time, check whether your appliance is
cooling.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 21: "Showroom mode is switched on."

symptoms.symptom: The refrigeration unit is switching on more frequently and for longer.

causes.label: The appliance has been opened frequently.
remedies: Do not open appliance door unnecessarily.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 21: "The appliance has been opened frequently."

causes.label: External ventilation openings are covered up.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 21: "External ventilation openings are covered up."

symptoms.symptom: A layer of frost forms on the back wall of the refrigerator compartment.

causes.label: Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines ensure a more even temperature in the refrigerator compartment. The back wall of the refrigerator compartment is defrosted automatically at regular intervals.
remedies: Only open the appliance door as briefly as necessary.
Pack the food airtight or cover it.
Allow hot food and drinks to cool down first before storing in the appliance.
Always leave some space between the food and the interior walls.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 22: "Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines ensure a more even temperature in the refrigerator compartment. The back wall of the refrigerator compartment is defrosted automatically at regular intervals."

symptoms.symptom: All temperature displays and "alarm off" light up.

causes.label: A sensor is defective.
remedies: Call customer service.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 23: "A sensor is defective."

causes.label: The customer service number can be found in the enclosed customer service directory.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 23: "The customer service number can be found in the enclosed customer service directory."

symptoms.symptom: A warning tone sounds and the set temperature (freezer compartment) and "alarm off" flash.

causes.label: Different causes are possible.
remedies: Press alarm off.
The alarm is switched off.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 23: "Different causes are possible."

causes.label: The freezer compartment door is open.
remedies: Close the freezer compartment door.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 23: "The freezer compartment door is open."

causes.label: External ventilation openings are covered up.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 23: "External ventilation openings are covered up."

causes.label: Larger quantities of fresh food have been put in.
remedies: Do not exceed the max. freezing capacity.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 23: "Larger quantities of fresh food have been put in."

symptoms.symptom: The set temperature is not reached.

causes.label: The freezer compartment door was open for a long time. The evaporator (refrigeration unit) in the noFrost
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 23: "The freezer compartment door was open for a long time. The evaporator (refrigeration unit) in the noFrost"

symptoms.symptom: Fully automatic defrosting no longer works.

causes.label: system is heavily iced up. Requirement: Store the frozen food well insulated in a cool place.
remedies: Switch off the appliance. Page 14
Disconnect the appliance from the mains. Unplug the appliance from the mains or switch off the circuit breaker in the fuse box.
Call customer service. The customer service number can be found in the enclosed customer service directory.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 23: "system is heavily iced up. Requirement: Store the frozen food well insulated in a cool place."

symptoms.symptom: The temperature differs greatly from the setting.

causes.label: Different causes are possible.
remedies: Switch off the appliance. Page 14
Switch the appliance back on after five minutes.
Page 13 If the temperature is too warm, check the temperature again after a couple of hours.
If the temperature is too cold, check the temperature again on the following day.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 23: "Different causes are possible."

causes.label: The water contained in warm and humid air condenses on the colder surfaces of the appliance.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 23: "The water contained in warm and humid air condenses on the colder surfaces of the appliance."

symptoms.symptom: A large volume of condensation collects regularly in the fruit and vegetable container.

causes.label: Depending on the food and quantity stored, condensation may form in the fruit and vegetable container.
remedies: Remove the fruit and vegetable container. Page 20
Remove the ventilation clips   and rotate them be-
fore inserting again .
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 24: "Depending on the food and quantity stored, condensation may form in the fruit and vegetable container."

symptoms.symptom: The appliance hums, bubbles, buzzes, gargles, clicks or crackles.

causes.label: Not a fault. A motor is running, e.g. refrigerating unit, fan. Refrigerant flows through the pipes. The motor, switches or solenoid valves are switching on or off. Automatic defrosting is running. No action required.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 24: "Not a fault. A motor is running, e.g. refrigerating unit, fan. Refrigerant flows through the pipes. The motor, switches or solenoid valves are switching on or off. Automatic defrosting is running. No action required."

causes.label: The appliance is not level.
remedies: Align the appliance using a spirit level and the screw feet.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 24: "The appliance is not level."

causes.label: The appliance is not free-standing.
remedies: Observe the minimum clearances for the appliance.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 24: "The appliance is not free-standing."

causes.label: Fittings wobble or stick.
remedies: Check the removable fittings and, if required, replace these.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 24: "Fittings wobble or stick."

causes.label: Bottles or containers are touching.
remedies: Move the bottles or containers away from each other.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 24: "Bottles or containers are touching."

causes.label: Super freezing is switched on. No action required.
causes.evidence: Siemens manual, page 24: "Super freezing is switched on. No action required."
